title: Accommodation
description: Nestled in the heart of Wilderness, our enchanting backpackers offers a magical retreat with room for every wandering soul. With cozy beds for up to 50 guests and a sprawling campsite that welcomes twice as many adventurers, we've created a space where lifelong friendships and unforgettable memories are made.

items.title: Camping
items.description: Bring your own tent and enjoy our beautiful campsite with access to shared facilities.

items.title: Safari Tent
items.description: Experience glamping in our comfortable safari tent, perfect for those who want to be close to nature.

items.title: Gypsy Caravan
items.description: Stay in our unique and charming gypsy caravan for a truly magical experience.

items.title: Mixed Dorm
items.description: Comfortable bunk beds in our mixed dormitory, perfect for solo travelers and backpackers.

items.title: Twin Room
items.description: Cozy room with two single beds, ideal for friends traveling together.

items.title: Family Room
items.description: Spacious room perfect for families, featuring multiple beds and shared facilities.

items.title: Five Sleeper
items.description: Large room that comfortably accommodates up to five people, perfect for groups or families.

items.title: Double En-suite
items.description: Private room with a queen size bed and en-suite bathroom for added comfort.

items.title: Family En-suite Rondawel
items.description: Traditional round African house with modern amenities, perfect for families seeking a unique stay.
